description: Regression fixtures for the felix-admin-capture classifier. Each fixture records a sample inbox block, the canonical destination capture should route it to, and a rationale that explains why. Used by tests/inbox/test_classifier_regression.py in two modes: (a) static — verify the routing table in capture's AGENTS.md still maps the destination string to a Step 4 action; (b) live (opt-in) — drive the actual capture prompt against the LLM.

fixtures.input_block: Dentist cleaning Wednesday June 10th at 2pm with Dr. Smith on Main Street. Should take an hour.
fixtures.rationale: Concrete one-off appointment with title, date, time, location, duration.

fixtures.input_block: Coffee with Pat tomorrow at noon for 30 minutes.
fixtures.rationale: Concrete event with relative date, time, and duration.

fixtures.input_block: Saturday June 13 9am to 5pm — woodworking workshop at Maker Space, 42 Industrial Way.
fixtures.rationale: All-day-ish event with explicit start, end, and location.

fixtures.input_block: Tuesday trivia nights at Tru West Brewery, 525 Massachusetts Ave, Acton, MA 01720, 6:00 PM, starting May 20.
fixtures.rationale: Weekly recurring event with title, weekday, time, location. From issue #324 — the precedent that motivated this whole mission.

fixtures.input_block: Biweekly 1:1 with my manager every other Wednesday at 10am — 1 hour.
fixtures.rationale: Biweekly cadence with weekday, time, duration. Recurrence phrase 'every other Wednesday' must convert to FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=WE.

fixtures.input_block: Pay credit card bill — monthly on the 15th at 9am, 15 minutes.
fixtures.rationale: Monthly on numeric day-of-month. Tests the FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=15 path.

fixtures.input_block: Dinner with the Smiths next Friday. Pick a place.
fixtures.rationale: Date is present but time is unspecified and end/duration absent → capture should request clarification.

fixtures.input_block: Set up a recurring 1:1 with Casey — biweekly Tuesdays at 3pm. Need to confirm start date.
fixtures.rationale: Recurrence and time present but start date is deferred to clarification.

fixtures.input_block: Quarterly review meeting starts June 15 at 9am — runs every other Tuesday in February only. 1 hour.
fixtures.rationale: Recurrence pattern is outside the supported set (every-other-Tuesday-in-February-only). Helper must report missing recurrence_pattern.

fixtures.input_block: Therapy session June 12 at 4pm.
fixtures.rationale: Start specified but neither end nor duration → capture clarifies before creating event.

fixtures.input_block: I want to get to bed earlier — it's the single biggest lever on my next-day energy.
fixtures.rationale: Standing intention without time or commitment. Maps to journal append, not a Vikunja task.

fixtures.input_block: I wonder whether a small-business loan would let us move faster on the Acton property without selling equity.
fixtures.rationale: Musing / wondering with no concrete next action. Belongs in journal, not as a task.

fixtures.input_block: Spend 15 minutes on growth practice today.
fixtures.rationale: From issue #556 misroute: this phrasing reads like an aspiration / intention, not a concrete actionable task. The pre-#556 classifier routed this to Vikunja by mistake.

fixtures.input_block: Get rid of the old lawn tractor at some point when I get around to it — no rush.
fixtures.rationale: Concrete future action explicitly tagged as no-deadline / when-I-get-around-to-it. Routes to Vikunja project Someday (id=4) per FR-009.

fixtures.input_block: Eventually want to clean out the garage and donate the stuff we don't use.
fixtures.rationale: Concrete action without time pressure. Belongs in Someday list, not a dated task.

fixtures.input_block: Buy a new spice rack for the kitchen at some point.
fixtures.rationale: From issue #556: household-items-routed-as-tasks misroute. This is a Someday item, not a dated active task.

fixtures.input_block: Call dentist to reschedule cleaning by Friday.
fixtures.rationale: Concrete near-term action with implied deadline. Belongs in Vikunja active list with due_date.

fixtures.input_block: Send last year's tax return PDF to Casey by EOD Wednesday.
fixtures.rationale: Explicit deadline + named recipient. Classic Vikunja active task with due_date.

fixtures.input_block: Prep slides for the all-hands on Thursday — outline + 5 slides.
fixtures.rationale: Near-term work tied to a known event date. Active task, not Someday.

fixtures.input_block: GitHub issue: add an --offset flag to scripts/inbox/prescan.py so the cron tick can replay older windows.
fixtures.rationale: Explicit 'GitHub issue:' trigger phrase. Maps to gh issue create.

fixtures.input_block: File a github issue: the prescan helper logs warnings even when PRESCAN_LOG_DIR is set to a tmpdir.
fixtures.rationale: Bug-report phrasing with explicit GitHub trigger. Goes to kentonium3/kg-automation.

fixtures.input_block: New goal: ship the inbox calendar routing mission to production this quarter.
fixtures.rationale: Felix-format goal declaration ('New goal:' or 'Update goal:'). Routes to 03-Constitution/Goals-MOC.md.

fixtures.input_block: Resource: 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications' by Martin Kleppmann — keep on the systems design shelf.
fixtures.rationale: Resource note pattern → 09-Resources/.

fixtures.input_block: Trivia at Tru West every Tuesday 6pm — and remind me to bring cash before Tuesday.
fixtures.rationale: Block contains a recurring calendar event AND a discrete active task. Capture should split into two routings (calendar event + active task).

fixtures.input_block: I want to write more this year. Block 30 minutes tomorrow at 7am to outline the next essay.
fixtures.rationale: Aspiration ('want to write more this year') + concrete time-boxed calendar event ('30 minutes tomorrow at 7am'). Two routings.
